title: a close pulls and pushes the commons it names, and retries a push origin outran
intention: close.sh's sync_repo pulls and pushes the repo it is handed (the commons included) under that repo's own door lock, and when a push fails it pulls --rebase and pushes again, at most 3 pushes in all, before stopping with NOT PUSHED and exit 5 as today.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: close exited 5 three times (a577fd03e307 once, ddbaaf055105 twice) with 'NOT PUSHED: /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons ... ! [rejected] main -> main (fetch first)' after a sealed hollow and a confirmed verdict. The bash -x trace (/home/akien/.akien/temp/close_ddbaaf055105_105122.log) shows sync_repo running `cd $d && cairn artifact quiet -- git pull -q --rebase --autostash`, and `cairn artifact quiet -- pwd` run from the commons prints the cairn root: bin/cairn chdirs there and _quiet passes no cwd, its -C (default '.') choosing only the lock. So the commons pull re-pulls the house under the house's lock, the commons is never pulled, and its push fails whenever origin moved at all; another hand crossing tickets into the commons every few seconds (11 origin commits in ~5 minutes) made that nearly every close.
traces_to: Law 7 (errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces and permanent in records of truth: the close names a push it never prepared for, and leaves the records it meant to land unpushed) and Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: the pull close.sh believes updates the commons updates the house).
how: In sync_repo, run every git through `git -C "$d"` under `cairn artifact quiet -C "$d" --` (pull and rebase --abort), push with `git -C "$d" push -q`, and loop: up to 3 times pull (a failed pull aborts its rebase and ends the loop), push, break on success. The ahead count, NOT PUSHED line and return 1 after the loop are unchanged. Red-first proof beside close.sh drives close.sh as written over scratch bare origins, with a git shim on PATH making origin move deterministically before close's pushes.

clauses.claim: a close whose commons origin took another hand's commit before the close began exits 0, the commons 0 commits ahead of origin, and origin holds both the close's record line and the other hand's commit
a close whose commons origin takes another hand's commit once, between the close's pull and its push, exits 0 with the commons 0 ahead and both commits on origin
a close whose commons origin takes another hand's commit before every push exits 5, prints NOT PUSHED naming the commons, and attempted exactly 3 pushes to the commons
a close over a commons in sync with origin exits 0 with the commons 0 ahead, as before
979a's diverged-commons tooth passes only on a pushed commons (rc 0, 0 ahead, the close's line on origin), so it reds on a close.sh whose commons pull runs in the house

decisions.text: D1: sync_repo runs `$C/bin/cairn artifact quiet -C "$d" -- git -C "$d" pull -q --rebase --autostash` (and the same for `rebase --abort` after a failed pull) and `git -C "$d" push -q`, inside a loop of at most 3 tries: pull; a failed pull aborts its rebase and ends the loop; push; success ends the loop. The ahead count, NOT PUSHED line and return 1 after the loop stay as written.

D2: the proof copies the scaffolding of 979a's proof (_repo, _world, _env, _close, _ahead and its bin/cairn and sail.py stubs) and adds a `git` shim first on PATH: its real git is shutil.which('git') taken before PATH changes; when argv holds `push` and its -C directory (or cwd) resolves to the scratch commons, it appends a line to a count file and, while the count is at most N (N=1 for clause 2, N=99 for clause 3, 0 otherwise), first pushes another hand's commit to the commons origin from a third clone; then it execs real git with the same argv. One tooth per clause.

D3: 979a's tooth test_a_diverged_commons_is_rebased_and_pushed_or_named passes only when the close exits 0, the commons is 0 commits ahead of origin, and origin holds the close's record line; the 'or NOT PUSHED' branch is removed, so the tooth reds on a close.sh that never pulls the commons (a hollow build). Its PROVES gains the key eb583e674939 mapping clause 5 to that tooth, beside the unchanged 979a63671481 key; the other teeth are unchanged; its seal is resealed in the build.

constraints: close.sh calls the artifact tool only through its published quiet verb with -C; _quiet itself is not changed (RULE 1: it is the artifact tool's interface)
after the 3rd failed push the close still stops with NOT PUSHED and exit 5 before any crossing it has not made (979a63671481)
